title: It seems loosely connected to the ceiling
description: Pointed Dripstone will now fall from the sky and hit everyone on the head.
body:
Pointed Dripstone will now fall from the sky and hit everone on the head.

Source of inspiration: [Casualties: Unknown]([https://orsonik.itch.io/scav-prototype](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4576490/Casualties_Unknown/)).

ps: `It seems loosely connected to the ceiling` is the original text in the game.

Mod configs:
* `detectionVerticalRange`: Detection Vertical Range
* `maxDamage`: Max Damage
* `damageMultiplier`: Damage Multiplier
